selection_rule: Exact registry work IDs with declared page_count 98-100 inclusive; all 137 Drive-readback PASS COMPLETE item folders are excluded.

constraints.rights: Recheck exact item location PDM and open access before retrieval.
constraints.retrieval: Anonymous official Wellcome API/IIIF only; same-identity documented routes and one bounded cooldown; no access-control bypass.
constraints.preservation: Every page, raw work metadata and actual retrieved manifest, hashes, Drive fingerprint readback, checkpoint and COMPLETE.
constraints.capacity_gate: Single bounded 11-item tranche / 1,090 declared pages; do not launch another tranche until terminal reconciliation.
constraints.dedupe: Skip exact PASS COMPLETE records; resume verified checkpoints; never replace a verified package silently.
